decisive_items: apex of the heart located at the right side of the chest
right atrium and right ventricle laid on the left side and the left atrium and left ventricle on the right side with its apex directed to the right
hepatic dullness that was located in the left subcostal region
response.rationale: R2 is supported by the physical exam and echocardiographic mirror-image arrangement: right-sided apex, left subcostal hepatic dullness, and reversed atria/ventricles, together establishing dextrocardia with situs inversus. R1 only matches the corrected ECG finding of complete RBBB, which is a secondary conduction finding and does not address the structural/positional diagnostic question.

rejected.why: R1 is supported only by ECG evidence of complete RBBB and does not explain the right-sided cardiac apex, left hepatic dullness, or reversed chamber arrangement; it is therefore a finding rather than the most likely diagnosis.
